metrics.caveat: One seed, not a published benchmark. Colab T4 attempt 1 reached these numbers, then the free GPU runtime ended before the final cell embedded PNGs or ONNX weights. Figures will be recovered on a T4 retry.
metrics.dataset: Sen1Floods11 official hand-labelled test split (90 chips), C-band Sentinel-1 VV/VH
metrics.note_int8: Dynamic INT8 quantization preserved water IoU on the 30-chip subset but was slower than FP32 on Colab CPU (not an edge device).

citations.credit: Bonafilia, Tellman, Anderson, Issenberg (2020). Sen1Floods11: a georeferenced dataset to train and test deep learning flood algorithms for Sentinel-1. CVPR EarthVision.
Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR, radiometrically terrain-corrected (RTC) via Microsoft Planetary Computer / ASF. Event context: 29 Oct 2024 DANA flood, Valencia, Spain.
citations.licence: Copernicus Sentinel open access (CC-BY-SA compatible attribution).

citations.credit: NASA-ISRO SAR (NISAR) Level-2 Geocoded Polarimetric Covariance (GCOV). Browse PNGs and granule metadata from NASA CMR / ASF DAAC. Full .h5 granules require a free Earthdata login and are not bundled in this local demo.
